label_definitions.REAL: Genuine human speech from public sources (interviews, podcasts, YouTube)
label_definitions.FAKE: AI-generated speech deepfakes targeting public figures

known_characteristics.real_sources: YouTube, interviews, podcasts -- varied recording conditions
known_characteristics.fake_sources: Multiple TTS/voice conversion systems targeting real speakers
known_characteristics.key_property: Both REAL and FAKE sourced from similar real-world recording conditions
known_characteristics.codec_confound_risk: LOW -- unlike FOR-2sec, both classes come from real-world recordings

itw_provenance.why_preferred_over_for2sec: Both REAL and FAKE recordings are sourced from real-world internet audio with similar recording/compression characteristics, removing the codec confound that invalidated the FOR-2sec experiment.
